subject: Competitive eval follow-up: model quality comparisons vs hyperscalers
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carter <alex@fintechco.com>, Sam Park <sam.park@cloudcorp.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call recap + next steps (model quality eval)

Thanks again for taking the call today \u0014 really helpful to understand FintechCo's risk profile and evaluation priorities. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Objectives you confirmed: quantify hallucination rates on financial question answering, measure instruction-following fidelity for multi-step workflows, and benchmark latency and top-line throughput against your current hyperscaler endpoints.
- Must-haves: SOC 2 evidence, data handling controls (no retention of PII by default), and the ability to run a private POC in your VPC if the initial results look good.
- Proposed tests: 
  1) Model-quality prompt suite (40 prompts) focused on transaction/statement QA and regulatory wording \u0014 you mentioned you can provide a redacted sample.
  2) Hallucination/regression checks using our hallucination-detector prompts + human spot-checking.
  3) Latency/throughput baselines vs Bedrock and Vertex for 1k/4k tokens.

Next steps: 
- Alex: share the redacted prompt set and a 200-line sample from production (PII redacted) by EOD Tue (4/20).
- Marissa/Redwood: we'll provision an eval project and run the 3 tests in a 1-week sprint; expected first results by 4/25.
- Internal: I'll loop in Rishi and Neha to own the tests and baseline collection.

Attachments: FintechCo_eval_prompts_v1.csv (placeholder), MAP_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan).

Thanks \u0014 talk soon.

--
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

On Tue, Apr 18, 2027 at 14:05 Alex Carter <alex@fintechco.com> wrote:
> Appreciate the demo earlier. Happy to get the sample prompts over \u0014 I'll redact PII and share tomorrow.
>
> - Alex
From: Alex Carter <alex@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Park <sam.park@cloudcorp.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (model quality eval)

Thanks Marissa \u0014 attaching the redacted prompt set and a 200-line sample (redacted) as requested. A couple clarifications: 

- We treat any 9-digit identifier as PII; removed those fields, left transaction descriptions.
- For regression checks, would you be able to show per-prompt delta vs our current provider (we use Bedrock for most QA flows)? A CSV with per-prompt verdicts would be ideal.
- Timeline: 4/25 initial results works for us. Also, can you confirm whether Redwood will store any of our sample prompts on the hosted side? We prefer ephemeral storage for the POC.

Attachments: FintechCo_eval_prompts_v1.csv, FintechCo_sample_200lines_redacted.csv

Appreciate it \u0014 Alex
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Carter <alex@fintechco.com>
Date: 2027-04-19T10:47:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Post-call recap + next steps (model quality eval)

Looping you in \u0014 Alex sent the prompt set and a redacted sample. Can you own the eval sprint? Key asks: 

- Run Redwood hosted eval (redwood-2.1) and fetch baseline metrics we already have against Bedrock (they asked per-prompt deltas).
- Tests to run this sprint (priority order):
  A) Hallucination detection (our auto-check + 5 human spot checks)
  B) Instruction-following / multi-step fidelity (10 multi-step prompts)
  C) Regression checks (per-prompt scoring vs Bedrock using the baseline rubric)
  D) Latency/throughput runs (1k tokens, 4k tokens) \u0013 note that FintechCo cares about 99th percentile latency for short queries.

Constraints: do not persist any PII/sample prompts on hosted storage \u0013 use ephemeral test buckets and redact outputs before storing any artifacts.

Timeline: kick off tomorrow 4/20; first pass results by 4/25. Please attach the output CSVs (per-prompt verdicts), a short summary slide, and baseline_results_redwood_vs_bedrock.csv.

Thanks \u0014 Marissa

> On Apr 19, 2027, Alex Carter wrote:
> > Sending over the files.
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-20T08:16:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Post-call recap + next steps (model quality eval)

Got it \u0014 we'll run the eval. Quick plan: 

1) Use the provided FintechCo_eval_prompts_v1.csv as the canonical prompt set; run Redwood-2.1 and Bedrock (existing credentials) through our eval harness.
2) Hallucination detector: run automated suite + sample 10 outputs for manual review (Neha to coordinate human checks).
3) Produce a per-prompt CSV with: prompt_id, expected_label, redwood_pass (yes/no), bedrock_pass (yes/no), redwood_hallucination_score (0-1), bedrock_hallucination_score (0-1), latency_ms_95th.

Deliverables by 2027-04-25 EOD: baseline_results_redwood_vs_bedrock.csv, short summary (1 slide), notes on any prompt failures and regeneration tests. Attaching existing baseline we ran last month to speed validation.

Attachments: baseline_results_redwood_vs_bedrock.csv, redwood-eval-scripts.zip

Rishi
Lead Applied ML, Redwood Inference
rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
From: Alex Carter <alex@fintechco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-30T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + next steps (model quality eval)

Thanks team \u0014 that timeline looks good. A few final items before you start: 

- Can Redwood confirm POC credits / commercial terms for this eval? We typically request a short-term credit to cover the evaluation usage.
- Any simple NDA / DPA form we should sign before you ingest the sample set?
- If results look promising we'd like to run a short private deployment in our AWS account next quarter \u0014 will need details on Private deployment requirements.

If you can reply with the two items above (credits + NDA/DPA) we'll consider the eval greenlit on our side.

\u0014 Alex

> Alex \u0014 we'll send a follow-up with POC credit confirmation and attach our standard DPA. I'll also include an intro to our Private deployment PM to scope the AWS on-prem steps if this goes well.
>
> Thanks \u0014 Marissa
